name: programme_unit

states.label: Proposed
states.description: Named as a unit of work, but not yet shaped — decision mode or door may still be unresolved.

states.label: Ready
states.description: Shaped and unblocked: mode and door are settled and the unit can be picked up as it stands.

states.label: In Review
states.description: The work is complete and is being checked before it lands.

states.label: Landed
states.description: The work merged and the unit is done.

states.label: Parked
states.description: Deliberately set aside; the unit still makes sense but is not being pursued.

states.label: Abandoned
states.description: Dropped without a successor — the unit no longer makes sense.

transitions.name: shape
transitions.description: Mode and door are settled; the unit can be picked up.

transitions.name: reshape
transitions.description: Send a ready unit back for reshaping.

transitions.name: submit
transitions.description: Put the finished work up for checking.

transitions.name: rework
transitions.description: Review found something; go back and change it.

transitions.name: land
transitions.description: The work is accepted and merged.

transitions.name: park
transitions.description: Set aside a unit before it was shaped.

transitions.name: park
transitions.description: Set aside a shaped unit without starting it.

transitions.name: park
transitions.description: Stop work in progress and set the unit aside.

transitions.name: abandon
transitions.description: Drop a unit that no longer makes sense.

transitions.name: abandon
transitions.description: Drop a shaped unit without starting it.

transitions.name: abandon
transitions.description: Drop a unit that is part-done.

transitions.name: abandon
transitions.description: Drop a unit whose result was rejected outright.

description: The working lifecycle of a programme unit. A unit is proposed once someone names it, becomes ready when its decision mode and door are settled and nothing blocks it, goes in_flight while the work is being done, and in_review while the result is being checked. landed, parked and abandoned are the three off-ramps and are final: landed means the work merged, parked means it was deliberately set aside as a whole, abandoned means it was dropped without a successor.
